{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion coil engine''', also known simply as an '''ion coil''', was a type of [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] twenty [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Frommon longhaul all-purpose transport]] was one example of a ship that used them.<ref name="Disturbance">{{ChallengeCite|66|Disturbance in the Force (article)}}</ref>
